rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a journey, excursion, or holiday outing.

example.english: We're going on a trip to Japan this summer.
example.traditional: 我哋今個暑假去日本旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 syu2 gaa3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this when someone catches a foot on something and stumbles, or when someone causes another person to fall.

example.english: They managed to trip over a wire while walking.
example.traditional: 佢哋行路嗰陣畀條電線絆倒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 haang4 lou6 go2 zan6 bei2 tiu4 din6 sin3 bun6 dou2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for going on a journey or taking a trip.

example.english: We’re taking a trip to Japan next month.
example.traditional: 我哋下個月去日本旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this for a remarkable or unusual experience rather than a physical journey.

example.english: Flying over the desert in a hot-air balloon was quite a trip.
example.traditional: 坐熱氣球飛過沙漠，真係一段難忘嘅經歷。
example.jyutping: co5 jit6 hei3 kau4 fei1 gwo3 saa1 mok6 zan1 hai6 jat1 dyun6 naan4 mong4 ge3 ging1 lik6

rows.note: Use this for a short trip made to accomplish a particular errand or purpose.

example.english: I'll make a quick trip to the convenience store later.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 heoi3 bin6 lei6 dim3 jat1 zyun3

rows.note: Use this when a person activates or sets off a trap, explosive, switch, or similar mechanism.

example.english: Be careful—touching this wire will trip the alarm.
example.traditional: 小心，掂到呢條線會觸發警報㗎。
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 dim3 dou2 ni1 tiu4 sin3 wui5 zuk1 faat3 ging2 bou3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a loss of footing or misstep, especially in more formal descriptions.

example.english: The official report attributed the fall to a trip.
example.traditional: 正式報告指，事主因失足從樓梯跌下。
example.jyutping: zing3 sik1 bou3 gou3 zi2 si6 zyu2 jan1 sat1 zuk1 cung4 lau4 tai1 dit3 haa6

rows.note: Use this when a device or system becomes activated, such as an alarm system switching on.

example.english: When the alarm sounded, the security system was activated, so we had to cancel the trip.
example.traditional: 警報一響，保安系統就啟動咗，我哋唯有取消行程。
example.jyutping: ging2 bou3 jat1 hoeng2 bou2 on1 hai6 tung2 zau6 kai2 dung6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 ceoi2 siu1 haang4 cing4
